findings.claim: Blackstone Infrastructure 以每股 $61.25 現金收購 TXNM Energy（EV $11.5B，2025-05 宣布）；股東 2025-08 通過，PUCT／FERC／FCC 已核准，NRC 與新墨西哥 PRC 未決；終止日延至 2027-05-31，預計 2027 上半年交割。

findings.claim: Blackstone 旗下基金 2026-07-20 宣布投資韓國致動器供應商 Futronic（媒體報導估值約 1 兆韓元／約 $675M），創辦人留任；官方稿未列價格。
findings.source: Blackstone 新聞稿：Blackstone Announces Investment in FUTRONIC

findings.excerpt: In May 2025, the Court declined to enter an approval order, holding that the Court’s approval is unnecessary and stating that the parties may settle as they see fit. Because an approval order was a condition to the settlement, the settlement agreement was terminated.
